items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve spoken with much pride and love about your son Jock

ctx.x: George, I’d like to return to something that I want to apologize to you for overlooking. I sort of pushed past it. But in our conversations yesterday and the day before, you’ve spoken with much pride and love about your son Jock, who was born, I believe, in 1965 in Sweden. Tell us a little bit about Jock and his mother, if you will. We’re dying to know.

Jock is a world traveler. That’s one thing about him. He’s very clever and very astute and very hip. He knows the world back and forth. He’s traveled all over. So from swimming with the sharks in the Eastern Hemisphere to being married to a lovely lady in Stockholm. He’s a traveler.
